Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Marco Island hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 30, 2026 snapshot, at 6 of the 14 Marco Island hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 3, Billabook.com at 1, Traveluro at 1 and Vio.com at 1. These are the Marco Island rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 5 of the 12 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 3, Billabook.com at 1 and Vio.com at 1 (a tie counts for each site). At the other 7, no site was 5% or more below it. The two counts differ: the study also counts the 2 named below that are not listed on this page. Each hotel below shows every site's all-in price. Across all cities: which booking site was lowest most often, measured.

Taxes and fees at Marco Island hotels

At the 6 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 11% ($23 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 10% at Cove Inn On Naples Bay to 11% at Olde Marco Island Inn & Suites. At 1 hotel the before-tax going rate was the same as the all-in one: the sites reported no taxes or fees on top. At 5 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
